content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The architecture for selling Notion templates for crypto is about more than just a payment method; it's about building an entire infrastructure that empowers creators. By leveraging free tools and services, you can create a sustainable e-commerce platform that circumvents conventional payment barriers. This matters because it enables creators in regions facing financial isolation to monetize their skills without exorbitant fees, thereby maximizing their income potential.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture uses a combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for order processing, and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. This setup allows you to automate product delivery as soon as a payment is confirmed on-chain. The free tools involved mean that you maintain full ownership of your data and your products, all while keeping operational costs extremely low.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where traditional payment processors often fail. If you're selling Notion templates or any digital product and are tired of high fees and limited options, this architecture was built for you. It provides a pathway to financial autonomy and sustainable income while embracing the growing popularity of cryptocurrency.
Gumroad's 10% cut means you lose nearly a tenth of your revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include a hosting platform (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), a backend logic system (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers), a storage solution (Supabase or Google Sheets), and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring seamless transactions and automated delivery, creating a frictionless experience for both you and your customers. Together, they form a robust stack that ensures sovereignty over your commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by selecting your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle orders. Connect your order storage solution, like Supabase, and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Finally, load your products and set up automated delivery. By following these steps, you can have your digital store operational without dependency on restrictive platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
With NOWPayments, you only pay 0.5% per transaction, maximizing your profits.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the necessary blueprints and templates to launch your sovereign online store. This can be particularly beneficial for those in regions where traditional payment options are unavailable. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook by using a sovereign architecture that includes free hosting, backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. This allows you to accept payments directly without relying on traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to build your own e-commerce stack using free tools and services. This way, you can avoid high platform fees and retain most of your earnings, especially with NOWPayments' low transaction fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by deploying a sovereign commerce stack that gives you full ownership of your sales process. This architecture eliminates reliance on platforms like Gumroad and Payhip.
What are the advantages of using crypto for payments?

Using crypto for payments allows for lower transaction fees, greater privacy, and faster processing. You maintain control over your sales without the restrictions imposed by traditional payment processors.
How can I automate product delivery?

You can automate product delivery by integrating Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script with your order management system. This setup ensures that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
